title: Play-Nice Contract Front Matter
description: Machine-readable front matter that must appear at the top of every canonical contract in contracts/.

contract_id.description: Unique, stable, machine-friendly identifier. Never reused, even after a contract is retired.

version.description: Semantic version of the contract text. PATCH = clarification only. MINOR = compatible new rule. MAJOR = meaningfully changed or incompatible behavior.

status.description: canonical = governs work. draft = may govern work but is expected to change. deprecated = superseded, do not adopt newly. retired = kept for provenance only.

layer.description: Library layer the contract lives in.

applies.description: Surfaces this contract can apply to (free-form tags, e.g. integration, api, ui).

triggers.description: Task characteristics that make this contract applicable. Matched by the resolver against task tags, descriptions, and surfaces.

supersedes.description: contract_id of an earlier contract this one replaces, if any.

rationale.description: One-paragraph reason this contract exists. Optional in front matter; the body must carry a fuller rationale section.
